title: Misleading UC Technicians - Fraud attempts
text:
Extremely Poor Experience – Misleading Diagnosis and Zero Customer Support

I had a very disappointing experience with Urban Company. I booked a washing machine repair service because the drum was not rotating.

When the technician visited, he claimed that a rat bite had damaged the motherboard and the water inlet pipe, and quoted ₹2,500 for the repair. I was suspicious of this diagnosis and decided not to proceed.

To get a second opinion, I contacted a local technician. He inspected the machine and fixed the issue for just ₹300. It turned out that only a few wires had been damaged, which he repaired simply by reconnecting and taping them.

The difference between the diagnosis and the actual repair is shocking. Quoting ₹2,500 for an issue that was resolved for ₹300 raises serious concerns about the technician’s honesty and technical expertise.

What made the experience even worse was Urban Company’s customer support. Despite explaining the entire incident, customer care refused to take any responsibility and declined to refund even the service fee. Their response was that they could not do anything from their end. This is completely unacceptable for a platform that claims to provide reliable and professional services.

Customers pay for the convenience and trust that Urban Company promises, but when something goes wrong, there seems to be no accountability or customer protection.

Urban Company needs to take responsibility for its technicians, investigate misleading quotations, and provide proper customer support.

My advice to other customers: Always get a second opinion before approving expensive repairs through Urban Company.

Extremely disappointing experience. I would think twice before using this platform again!

title: Worst service for Native water purifier
text:
Very Disappointing Experience with Native Water Purifier – Poor Product Performance and Customer Support

Extremely disappointed with Native Water Purifier. The battery backup is completely useless. Whenever there is a power cut, the purifier stops dispensing water, even when the storage tank is completely full. What is the point of having a battery backup if it doesn’t work when needed?

The worst part is the customer service. The technicians keep performing the same battery reset every time without actually identifying or fixing the issue. Instead of resolving the problem, they simply argue that the battery is working, while the actual problem remains unresolved.

We have repeatedly faced this issue, and there is no proper solution or accountability from the service team.

A water purifier is an essential household appliance, and customers expect reliable performance and proper after-sales service. Unfortunately, Native has failed on both fronts.

Highly disappointing product experience and pathetic after-sales support. I would not recommend this product unless Native improves its product reliability and customer service.

title: Professional and very co-operative
text:
Had booked for deep cleaning a week ago. Booking was user-friendly and hassle-free. I was worried if we could avail additional cleaning services apart from the ones we opted in the app. But we could, there was enough flexibility. 

The urban company staff led by minhajul Islam were very cooperative and professional. It was like they just kept cleaning whatever they found dusty in the rooms. And the way they cleaned needs a mention, the objects be it the fans, tables, mixie anything they found was cleaned so well it looked like a newly bought item. The toilets are shining bright. 

One particular thing I liked about them is - they just don’t dump all objects in the tables and showcase somewhere, clean and place them wherever they felt like or abandon it and leave it to the customer to arrange themselves, they clean and place the objects where exactly they were. 

Every time we got our homes cleaned, we lost things due to misplacement but the staff led by minhaj never allowed for it. 

Although slightly expensive, we got our money’s worth completely. They deserved all the pay for the work they do

I highly recommend urban clap for deep cleaning
